name: Astra Inania
source:
Astra Inania is a sci-fi visual novel with investigative and horror elements.

You are a space technician who owes a serious debt to the company that raised you. You've got a plan. At least, you believe you do. For the past year, you've been gathering data so you can leave the sector for good.

Now you're being sent to repair a Relay that has stopped working. Legally, they have to send at least two people, so they hire the cheapest Freelancer they can find and send you off. Twenty-two days on a ship with a complete stranger who is bigger and stronger than you.

What could possibly go wrong?

But more importantly...

What happened to the crew stationed at Relay 9?

FEATURES

- Be polite, friendly, direct or blunt. Either way, YOU decide.
- A colorful cast of characters, inspired by Slavic mythology
- Multiple endings (not available in the demo)
- Accessibility options: narration, high-contrast mode, text speed and more
- Romance: optional
translation:
《Astra Inania》是一部融合调查解谜与恐怖元素的科幻视觉小说。

你是一名太空技术员，背负着把你抚养长大的公司压在你头上的巨额债务。但你心里已有盘算——至少你自己深信不疑。过去一年间，你一直在暗中搜集数据，只为彻底逃离这片星区。

如今，公司指派你前去抢修一座停止运转的中继站。按法规要求至少需派遣两人同行，于是公司雇来了能找到的最廉价自由佣兵，将你们二人一并打发上路。接下来整整二十二天，你都得和一个素昧平生、体型比你更高大强壮的陌生人共处一艘飞船。

这能出什么岔子呢？

但更重要的是……

驻守在9号中继站的工作人员究竟遭遇了什么？

游戏特色

• 礼貌、友善、直率或是生硬——无论哪种态度，全由你做主。
• 取材自斯拉夫神话的多彩角色群像
• 多重结局（试玩版暂未开放）
• 无障碍辅助选项：旁白朗读、高对比度模式、文字速度调节等功能
• 恋爱要素：自由可选
